description: Intent i004 (af-packet-tpacket-rings, snapshot s01) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): net/packet/af_packet.c tpacket_snd(), lines 2821-2837. With PACKET_VNET_HDR set, vnet_hdr = data points into the mmap'd TX ring frame (po->tx_ring.pg_vec user-shared pages, concurrently writable by unprivileged userspace, no lock/READ_ONCE between fetches). Fetch 1 (validation, line 2826): __packet_snd_vnet_parse(vnet_hdr, tp_len) enforces hdr_len <= tp_len and csum_start+csum_offset+2 <= hdr_len (af_packet.c:2532-2541). Fetch 2 (unvalidated re-read, lines 2830-2831): copylen = __virtio16_to_cpu(vio_le(), vnet_hdr->hdr_len) re-reads hdr_len from the same shared frame with no re-validation. Unsafe use: copylen sizes the skb via sock_alloc_send_skb(... hlen + tlen + sizeof(struct sockaddr_ll) + (copylen - dev->hard_header_len)) (lines 2834-2837) and drives tpacket_fill_skb's skb_put(skb, copylen - dev->hard_header_len) and skb_store_bits(skb, 0, data, hdrlen=min(copylen, tp_len)) (lines 2600-2613) — a race between the two reads can raise copylen above the validated tp_len (up to 65535), leaving transmitted linear skb area uninitialized (heap disclosure) and sizing allocation/put arithmetic with an unvalidated value. A third re-read of the same shared header occurs at line 2869 (virtio_net_hdr_to_skb) after skb fill. Rejected non-candidates with evidence: tpacket_parse_header (2649-2715) single-fetches tp_len/tp_mac/tp_net into locals and validates before returning; packet_snd_vnet_parse (2546-2567) snapshots the header via copy_from_iter_full; tpacket_rcv (2228+) is the kernel-writer path; virtio_net.h:97-105 csum re-read is itself re-validated via pskb_may_pull + skb_partial_csum_set. Limitations: no dynamic reproducer (static analysis only), ring-setup/diag/TPACKET_V3 block-retire paths not exhaustively audited, impact of the line-2869 mixed-fetch beyond internal re-validation not fully characterized.
